title: Bonfire E2E Release-Gate Verdict
description: The compiled output of a release-gate box run. All assertions must be true for a PASS verdict. The schema IS the contract: to tighten the bar, add an assertion here.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this box run, e.g. e2e-20260416-143022

wave.description: Wave number the gate is evaluating

bonfire_version.description: Version of the bonfire-ai artifact the box installed and executed, read back from the installed package (not from the prompt, not from PyPI metadata).

artifact_under_test.description: Identity of the artifact the box graded. Written host-side by e2e-box.sh when it builds the wheel, verified by sha256 inside the container before install, and merged into this verdict by e2e-runner.sh. A verdict without this block graded an unknown artifact.

sha256.description: Digest of the wheel file the container installed.

source_commit.description: Commit the wheel was built from, or 'unknown' outside a git checkout.

source_dirty.description: Whether the source tree had uncommitted changes at build time.

built_by.description: How the wheel was produced, or the operator-supplied path when BONFIRE_WHEEL was set.

bonfire_execution.description: The `bonfire run` invocation that produced the graded artifacts. Absent means the artifact under test was never executed, which is itself a FAIL.

exit_code.description: Non-zero forces verdict=FAIL and a bonfire_run_failed failure reason.

stdout_path.description: Path, relative to the run output directory, of the captured stdout.

stderr_path.description: Path, relative to the run output directory, of the captured stderr.

session_log_path.description: Session log Bonfire actually wrote, resolved after the run.

stderr_tail.description: Last lines of Bonfire's stderr, so the verdict names the failure instead of a generic timeout.

assertions.description: Mechanical pass/fail checks. All must be true for PASS.

broken_test_now_passes.description: The deliberately broken test named in the fixture now passes.

no_regressions.description: All tests that were green before the run remain green.

pr_opened.description: Bonfire's publisher created a named PR branch.

test_files_untouched.description: The diff contains zero changes under tests/.

src_files_modified.description: The diff contains at least one change under src/.

review_verdict_emitted.description: Review Agent produced a verdict artifact.

cost_log_present.description: .bonfire/costs.jsonl exists and parses as valid JSONL.

failure_reasons.description: When verdict=FAIL, the failed assertion names. Empty or absent when PASS.
